_info: Stock (standard) configuration of ONE engine, loaded automatically when this engine is selected and by the button 'Load stock configuration'. File name = engine id. 'chargers': a catalog id (string) or {"profile": {...}, "count": n} for a part that belongs to this engine only. Maps use the shared rpm axis [800,2000,3500,5000,6000,7000] and load axis [0,25,50,75,100] ([loadIdx][rpmIdx]). 'reference' holds a known factory power figure for later calibration.
name: Ford Kent 1.6L (Crossflow) - stock configuration
generated: ignition and fuel maps derived from the shared base maps: rpm axis stretched to this engine's redline, fuel scaled by displacement per cylinder, ignition for a naturally aspirated engine (low-load row, 0.1 deg retard per % load)

reference.standard: PS (CV) as published by encycarpedia, converted to mechanical hp with 1 hp = 1.01387 PS
reference.variant: 1.6 Crossflow (711M block), Ford Escort Mk2 1.6 Ghia 1975-1978, 9.0:1, 80.98 x 77.62 mm
reference.source: encycarpedia.com 1975 Ford Escort 1.6 Ghia: 85 PS (CV) at 5500 rpm, 125 N·m at 3500 rpm, 9:1, 80.98 x 77.62 mm, Kent Crossflow
reference.notes: Power, torque, bore/stroke and compression 9.0:1 come from one database entry for the 1.6 Crossflow in Escort Mk2 form, so bore/stroke and compression are now verified. A Corgi model listing for the Mk2 1600 Sport gives 83 bhp at 5500 rpm and 92 lb-ft at 4800 rpm. It agrees on peak power and is used as a cross-check; the torque peak differs (4800 vs 3500 rpm), so the encycarpedia values are used. Carburettor and market specs vary for this engine, so this is one reference configuration.
